desc: classification: equal-symbol run inherits the OPPOSITE type
old: byte isS = c < next || (c == next && nextIsS != 0) ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;
new: byte isS = c < next || (c == next && nextIsS == 0) ? (byte)1 : (byte)0;

desc: classification: position n-1 treated as S-type for the equal-symbol rule
old: byte nextIsS = 0;
new: byte nextIsS = 1;

desc: round 1 placement starts from the sentinel type (position n-1 may be seeded as LMS)
SetBucketHeads leaves the last bucket unset (stale workspace value)
old:
int sum = 1; // index 0 belongs to the sentinel suffix
        for (int c = 0; c < sigma; c++)
new:
int sum = 1; // index 0 belongs to the sentinel suffix
        for (int c = 0; c < sigma - 1; c++)

desc: SetBucketTails stores the start instead of the exclusive end (N05 swapped two lines and made the method identical to SetBucketHeads: rejected by the analyzer, redone)
old:
sum += counts[c];
            bkt[c] = sum; // exclusive end
new:
bkt[c] = sum - counts[c]; // exclusive end
            sum += counts[c];

desc: CompactSortedLms stops one entry early (SA[n] is an L-type suffix: equivalent expected)
CompactSortedLms: predecessor test inverted
old: types[p] != 0 && types[p - 1] == 0) sa[1 + k++] = p;
new: types[p] != 0 && types[p - 1] != 0) sa[1 + k++] = p;

desc: CompactNames does not advance the write index
new: if (v >= 0) sa[j] = v;

desc: translation of the reduced ranks is the identity on the LMS list
old: for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) sa[i] = sa[tailBase + sa[i]];
new: for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) sa[i] = sa[tailBase + i - 1];

desc: round 2 placement clears the source entry AFTER the write (erases the entry when slot == r)
M08 analogue: always recurse (names <= m)
workspace of a level is never released (leak, result unchanged)
CompactSortedLms admits p == 0 (reads types[-1])
old: if (p > 0 && types[p] != 0 && types[p - 1] == 0) sa[1 + k++] = p;

desc: trace: LMS count of the level off by one
old: trace?.Levels.Add(new SaisLevel(n, sigma, m));
new: trace?.Levels.Add(new SaisLevel(n, sigma, m + 1));

desc: LMS count: S-type position with S-type predecessor
old: m += nextIsS & (isS ^ 1);
new: m += nextIsS & isS;

desc: round 2 placement into the exclusive bucket end (no -1)
direct placement of distinct names skips the last reduced symbol
old: for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) sa1[1 + s1[i]] = i;
new: for (int i = 0; i < m - 1; i++) sa1[1 + s1[i]] = i;

desc: round 2 clears SA[m] (the largest sorted LMS entry) before it is read
old: sa.Slice(m + 1).Fill(Empty, n - m);
new: sa.Slice(m).Fill(Empty, n - m + 1);

desc: CompactNames skips the name slot 1 + m (LMS position 1 or 0)
old: for (int i = n; i > m; i--)
new: for (int i = n; i > m + 1; i--)

desc: bucket tails of round 2 start at 0 instead of 1
symbol counting accepts symbol == sigma only on the 16-bit path (counts block too small by one entry)
old: Buf<int> counts = arena.Allocate<int>(sigma, zero: true, "counts");
new: Buf<int> counts = arena.Allocate<int>(sigma > 1 ? sigma - 1 : sigma, zero: true, "counts");

desc: EQUIVALENCE PROBE of S06: types[n] is read nowhere. Shrunk block, no write at index n, span of n; a read of types[n] throws
old: Buf<byte> types = arena.Allocate<byte>(n + 1, zero: false, "types");
new: Buf<byte> types = arena.Allocate<byte>(n, zero: false, "types");

desc: EQUIVALENCE PROBE of S11: the stray write of CompactNames lands on slot n - m; make it the hostile value int.MaxValue (not a plausible name or position)
EQUIVALENCE PROBE of S13: SA[0] holds a hostile value between the direct placement and the end of SolveReduced
new: sa1[0] = int.MaxValue;

desc: EQUIVALENCE PROBE of S17: after the round 2 clear, SA[n] holds a VALID-LOOKING position (n - 1) that would corrupt the L pass if it were ever read before being written
old: sa.Slice(m + 1).Fill(Empty, n - m);
new:
sa.Slice(m + 1).Fill(Empty, n - m);
        sa[n] = n > 1 ? n - 1 : 0;

desc: EQUIVALENCE PROBE of S19: after the round 1 clear, SA[n] holds a VALID-LOOKING position (n - 1)
old: sa.Slice(1).Fill(Empty, n);
new:
sa.Slice(1).Fill(Empty, n);
        sa[n] = n > 1 ? n - 1 : 0;
